name: Kotoneiro
source:
It's springtime, and spring break is just around the corner
I was spending my days with my childhood friend, Koto, in a way that was neither good nor bad.
But I'm a young man now, and I want to take my relationship with Koto-nee a step further as I go to college!
Even though I thought that, I couldn't quite bring myself to do it.

Then one day, Koto-nee made a suggestion.

"If Akito becomes a regular on the club, I'll grant you one wish."
My new life began with a sudden and unexpected opportunity.​
